newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via o/n, 6-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via o/n, 6-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system on Thursday via overnight and six-day system repurchase agreements, the New York Fed said.
The RPs are for fixed collateral, the Fed said.

Analysts had forecast a round of 5-day system RPs to meet the projected average daily add need of $3.5 billion to $5 billion during the current maintenance period, which began this session. Thursday's operation is seen covering the period through the long Martin Luther King Jr Day holiday on Monday, when the Fed is closed.
Federal funds were at the 5-1/4 percent target rate.
